items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the category of motives is additive (statement lines 1046-1048). The proof (proof lines 1049-1071) constructs direct sums by disjoint unions when the twists agree and reduces the general case using the identification of the twisted projective line motive with an inverse twist of the unit. H2: a complete short argument.
